title: SpaceX spooks investors with debut earnings report
excerpt: Shares slide in pre-market trading even as group says its quarterly revenues nearly doubled.
content_html:
SpaceX’s AI revenue more than trebled from the previous quarter to $2.56 billion, with the majority of that coming from deals to lease data center capacity to rival AI groups including Anthropic and Google.

That approach has boosted SpaceX’s short-term revenues while limiting its capacity to train and run its own competitive AI models.

Dec Mullarkey, managing director of SLC Management, said SpaceX’s data center leasing could hamper it. “Their margins are going to be capped if they are primarily a cloud company,” he said.

SpaceX’s $1.65 trillion market capitalization also hinges on Musk achieving ambitious goals such as reaching Mars with reusable rockets, putting data centers into orbit, and playing a critical role in developing AI.

Goldman Sachs, a bookrunner on SpaceX’s offering, expects the company’s AI revenue to increase 100-fold by 2030. Musk said on Tuesday that SpaceX could hit $1 trillion in revenue by the end of the decade.

On the earnings call, Musk said SpaceX had made progress on its first generation of orbital data centers, dubbed Starmind AI-1. “This is not some sort of far-future, distant thing. We expect to start launching these next year.”

The latest series of Grok AI models are being trained on SpaceX data, which Musk said would give his company’s tools an edge in engineering.

Musk also argued that the potential of the group’s Starlink unit—which provides satellite Internet—was “under-appreciated.”

Some traders have been putting on bets against SpaceX shares in recent weeks. Short interest in the company has risen to the equivalent of 220 million shares, or roughly 34 percent of the shares that are freely trading, according to data provider S3 Partners.

Analysts at Deutsche Bank said the end of the stock’s initial lock-up period for employees on Thursday was weighing on SpaceX’s equity price. The German bank also said “lower than expected” buying by passive funds that track indices was affecting SpaceX’s shares after it was added to the Nasdaq 100 index last month.

Investors are also weighing the probability of Musk merging SpaceX with Tesla after previously consolidating parts of his business empire.

Musk said the electric-car maker was increasingly collaborating with SpaceX, including through Terafab, a semiconductor manufacturing initiative, during Tesla’s earnings call last month.

He added that any merger would have to take place under the “appropriate process.”

content_html_zh:
SpaceX 的人工智能收入比上一季度增长了两倍多，达到 25.6 亿美元，其中大部分来自向包括 Anthropic 和谷歌在内的竞争对手人工智能集团租赁数据中心容量的交易。

这种方法提高了 SpaceX 的短期收入，但限制了其训练和运行自己的竞争性人工智能模型的能力。

SLC Management 董事总经理 Dec Mullarkey 表示，SpaceX 的数据中心租赁可能会阻碍这一进程。 “如果他们主要是一家云公司，他们的利润将会受到限制，”他说。

SpaceX 1.65万亿美元的市值还取决于马斯克实现雄心勃勃的目标，例如利用可重复使用的火箭到达火星、将数据中心送入轨道以及在开发人工智能方面发挥关键作用。

SpaceX 发行的账簿管理人高盛预计，到 2030 年，该公司的人工智能收入将增长 100 倍。 马斯克周二表示，到本世纪末，SpaceX 的收入可能会达到 1 万亿美元。

在财报电话会议上，马斯克表示 SpaceX 在其第一代轨道数据中心（称为 Starmind AI-1）方面取得了进展。 “这不是什么遥远的未来、遥远的事情。 我们预计明年开始推出这些产品。”

最新系列的 Grok AI 模型正在 SpaceX 数据上进行训练，马斯克表示这将使他公司的工具在工程方面具有优势。

马斯克还认为，该集团提供卫星互联网的星链部门的潜力“未被充分认识”。

最近几周，一些交易员一直在做空 SpaceX 的股票。 根据数据提供商 S3 Partners 的数据，该公司的空头权益已增至相当于 2.2 亿股，约占自由交易股票的 34%。

德意志银行分析师表示，周四该公司股票最初的员工禁售期结束，给 SpaceX 的股价带来压力。 这家德国银行还表示，追踪指数的被动基金的购买量“低于预期”，正在影响 SpaceX 上个月被纳入纳斯达克 100 指数后的股价。

在此前整合了部分商业帝国后，投资者也在权衡马斯克将 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并的可能性。

马斯克在特斯拉上个月的财报电话会议上表示，这家电动汽车制造商正在越来越多地与 SpaceX 合作，包括通过半导体制造计划 Terafab 进行合作。

他补充说，任何合并都必须在“适当的程序”下进行。
